specializations.description: Subclass specializations for each calling, chosen at level 3 (Tier 2)

dedication.name: Exemplar
dedication.description: Tactical weapon master. Spends Resolve on combat maneuvers for precision, control, and defense.
dedication.flavorText: You have pushed beyond raw strength into something rarer — the ability to read a fight and shape it. Every exchange is an opportunity.
dedication.playstyle: Tactical weapon master with combat maneuvers for precision, control, and defense

dedication.name: Oath
dedication.description: Sworn warrior. Spends Resolve on Sworn Strike (burst radiant damage) or Aid the Vulnerable (healing and condition cleanse). Every smite point is healing you don't have.
dedication.flavorText: The source of your power is not a god or a patron. It is the oath itself — a promise made and kept through blood and will.
dedication.playstyle: Sworn warrior with burst damage or healing — every smite point is healing you don't have
